# ChannelRadius <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [3D Sound](Blitz3D-3D-Sound)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ChannelRadius:Void channel:Int32, radius:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | In | Int32 | required | A channel handle from [EmitSound](EmitSound). |
| `radius` | In | Float32 | required | The radius in units of the world. `0` (what a channel starts with) is a point. Below 0 is a runtime error. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Makes the source of one 3D sound a ball instead of a point, such as a big engine or a waterfall. Together with [ListenerRadius](ListenerRadius) it makes the sound move between the speakers and change its pitch over a moment as it passes close by. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Differences

* A channel that is over is ignored. [GetChannelRadius](GetChannelRadius) tells the value.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
engine = EmitSound(rumble, mothership)
ChannelRadius engine, 50
```
